scientific_question: Does linearly annealing ONLY the late English learning rate (global updates 101-200, English ordinal j=1..90: lr=5e-5*(90-j)/89, binding LR constant 5e-5) prevent the constant-LR Owen-side boundary sweep that left SF2 at 15/16, while preserving SF2 retention?
rationale_for_matched_prefix: PATH1: cross-process bitwise identity is stochastic on this ROCm/torch stack and no runtime fix was found; PATH2: no independently justifiable numerical-equivalence standard exists. A single-process fork gives both arms an EXACT shared in-process prefix, so only the LR schedule differs. Post-fork stochastic divergence is identically distributed across arms and bounded at endpoint level by the measured cross-mode noise floor (<=6.97e-3 nats/item at u200, zero margin-sign flips), 10-100x smaller than the boundary movements the hypothesis concerns.
seed_policy: chosen and frozen before any treatment outcome; distinct; no post-outcome selection

design_per_seed.step1: fresh process, runtime identical to SF2/SF3/SF4; configure_runtime(seed), PYTHONHASHSEED=seed
design_per_seed.step2: shared prefix: global updates 1-100 with exact SF2 semantics (frozen SF2 engine code path; data/schedule/KL/objective/scope/optimizer/dropout modes unchanged)
design_per_seed.step3: at update 100, capture full in-process snapshot (model, optimizer, RNG, english_index, scope, provenance) BEFORE any RNG-consuming evaluation; snapshot consumes no training RNG
design_per_seed.step4: arm A (control): restore snapshot; updates 101-200 at constant English LR 5e-5
design_per_seed.step5: arm B (treatment): restore the SAME snapshot; updates 101-200 English LR lr(j)=5e-5*(90-j)/89, j=1..90; binding LR 5e-5
design_per_seed.step6: evaluate both arms at update 200 with identical frozen endpoint definitions

replicate_count_justification: 3 shared prefixes + 6 arm continuations (~2-4 min each on this machine); each seed is an independent draw of dropout/initialization noise; results are exact paired counts, not population inference

preserved_semantics.objective_english: causal answer+EOS CE (5 positions) + 1.0 x forward KL D_KL(student||Pilot1) over 160 frozen ordinary positions/English update; student KL in eval mode with grads; factual CE in train mode; T=1; full 1024-class support; float64 KL accumulation (unchanged)
preserved_semantics.objective_binding: pinned T13 answer CE + LAM 1.0536573711078283 hard-min localization (unchanged)
preserved_semantics.scope: English trains embeddings, blocks 4-7, final norm, untied head; blocks 0-3 and T13 frozen. Binding full scope.
preserved_semantics.optimizer: fresh AdamW 5e-5 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 wd.05 amsgrad=False foreach=False fused=False; clip 2.0; one persistent state per arm from the shared snapshot; no scheduler object
preserved_semantics.schedule: global 200 updates = 20x(9 English + 1 binding); shared prefix = updates 1-100; arm window = 101-200

gates_per_arm.acquisition_endpoint: correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND families==4 at update 200
gates_per_arm.language: aligned DEV CE <= own update-0 CE + 0.25 at updates 100/200
gates_per_arm.binding: each pool independently answer>=76 AND BD>=76 AND collapse==0 at updates 0/100/200
gates_per_arm.prefix_acquisition_guard: if correct<10 AND exact<10 at update 100, stop
gates_per_arm.transfer_lock: HELDOUT16/ALTERNATE48/COPY8/COMPETING64 open per-arm ONLY if that arm passes ALL endpoint gates at 200; else locked

endpoints.primary_per_replicate: binary endpoint-gate pass at update 200, control vs treatment (all acquisition AND retention gates); reported per arm per seed
endpoints.secondary: per-item margins at updates 125/150/175/200 for all 16 TRAIN items; four AO cell midpoints; Owen/Alex subgroup margins; margin of residual item TRAIN:g0:carried:wooden boat:a0; language CE, D3 mass, binding summaries at 200

decision_rule.support: treatment passes the endpoint acquisition gate in >=2 of 3 replicates while its matched control does not, and treatment never fails where control passes
decision_rule.weak_or_no_support: both arms pass in all replicates where control passes, or both fail in all replicates (report margins descriptively)
decision_rule.harm: treatment fails in any replicate where control passes (>=1 such pair)
decision_rule.statistics: exact counts and margins only; no p-values, no population generalization claims

next_action_at_execution_time: build and freeze an SF5 controller derived from the frozen SF2 engine that adds full-snapshot capture at update 100, in-process snapshot restore, and per-arm LR selection after the fork, with updates 1-100 loop, objectives, scope, evaluation and gate code byte-identical to the frozen controller logic; then run the design. Not performed here.
